A very bad experience at this store.

I came in with a problem on a water dispenser I recently purchased. Instead of getting clear technical explanations, I received answers that seemed inconsistent and unprofessional.
When I expressed my doubts and asked to speak to the store manager, the situation quickly deteriorated. I felt ignored and unfairly labeled, when all I wanted was to understand the source of the problem.
The product is working now, but I left feeling particularly disappointed by the poor customer service, the lack of communication, and the disregard shown to the customer. This experience has certainly not made me want to return.
Great local shop! Good prices!
All Animalis stores are very good, excellent value for money, the best store for me!
A huge thank you to Noémie for her invaluable advice and kindness!
Always a very warm welcome
A very well-run store by the team.

Very bad experience.

We ordered two bags of cat food for our cats, including a specific "urinary" bag for a sick cat, with delivery promised within 2 hours.

Ultimately, the order wasn't ready that day, even though it was supposed to be picked up the day before, and we were asked to wait another 2 to 3 days, which is completely unacceptable as we had run out of cat food.

As a person with a disability, my son handles transportation. So we called the store, and a salesperson confirmed that they had found one of the two bags and were setting it aside for my son to pick up.

Once there, my son was refused the product. The saleswoman even asked him the price of the bag, as if it were a regular purchase, even though it was clearly an order that had already been paid for and confirmed in his name. She refused to give him the product without making him pay again.

I called the store back to understand this contradiction. I was told that the salesperson “had told me nonsense” and that I had to pay again on the spot, without any explanation or willingness to find a solution.

I am also very surprised that I received neither an apology nor an explanation for all this disorganization. Instead of acknowledging their mistake and looking for a solution, the staff remained closed off and unprofessional.

They took no account of our situation, nor of the fact that there are significant constraints, especially for a sick cat who needs his special food.

Furthermore, I can't even cancel the order, which was confirmed yesterday, to buy elsewhere.

Result: disorganized service,

contradictory information, no sense of customer service, and no respect for customers.

This is the second time we've had problems with this store. This time, it's over; we won't order from them again.

I strongly advise against it.

Thank you for your stars!

A really great shop! The staff gave me a very warm welcome at 7 pm, just before closing time, which isn't always the best time in retail to take your time, but the sales assistants on duty did so very easily and enthusiastically.

The shop was impeccably maintained, and the products were varied and plentiful. I highly recommend it. Thank you!

I want to thank the entire store team for their warm welcome and professionalism. The salespeople are truly attentive, offer excellent advice, and take the time to explain things thoroughly without ever rushing.

You can tell they know animals inside and out and are passionate about their work. It's very reassuring to receive this kind of support.

I also want to highlight their great professionalism when dealing with customers who are sometimes grumpy or impatient: they know how to remain calm, polite, and professional in all circumstances.

Thank you again for your kindness and helpfulness; I highly recommend this store :)

I come here regularly. Everything is always perfect. I always try to go through a young man whose name I don't know. He's always ready to listen and offers good advice on nutrition, health, and more. He's truly very professional; he helps us with our purchases, advises us, and is always available. I always try to speak with him when he's there.

I highly recommend this establishment and especially this gentleman.
They're selling a flea treatment for €27.50 that costs €15.50 at the Prado Mermoz pharmacy, just 50 meters away. What nerve to inflate their profit margins like that!

The welcome was fantastic and very friendly! Right at the entrance, they offered water for our four-legged friends, a lovely touch that's always appreciated.

The staff are truly attentive; you can tell they love animals and enjoy their work.

A huge thank you to Manon, always smiling, passionate, and full of great advice. I highly recommend it!!

I went into the store. Two salespeople were unpacking boxes of merchandise. Neither of them looked up to ask if I needed help or even to say hello. Don't complain if consumers buy online...

It's a lovely initiative to invite animal welfare organizations; a chance to think about abandoned or stray animals 🩷 …

The prices are high, which I can accept given its location. However, the service is deplorable. On my first visit, one employee was lecturing another about a recent near-alcohol-induced coma. Doing so privately would have been wise, but oh well... On my last visit—and I mean last, because I won't be going back—there were four salespeople, and I was the only customer. I asked for help finding an item, received completely irrelevant advice, and then the item was out of stock (it happens). I started asking the two salespeople next to me for an alternative, but they had already gone off to chat with their colleagues... If you don't need anything, go ahead, it's the right place!

It was such a wonderful experience for us!!

The store is clean, well-organized, and you can tell that the well-being of the animals is their priority. My dog ​​loves going there—he always gets super excited when we approach the door!

A big thank you to the whole team for your professionalism and kindness. I will definitely be back!

My little one was groomed at Animalis. Everything went very well, my little one came out looking beautiful. The groomer is lovely, I'll definitely go back.

All the staff are incredibly welcoming and friendly! I just adopted my first dog and they gave me excellent advice! The selection is admittedly smaller compared to other Animalis stores, but that's the case for all types of stores, whether they're in the city or the shopping center (like Decathlon, Gifi, etc.), so it's to be expected. Liam, the groomer, is lovely; he took care of my dog ​​with care and professionalism. All in all, I have absolutely no complaints.
Disappointed with this store, there wasn't much choice of fish and it's a small store, which is a shame.

The "paradisio" hay is very expensive and of very poor quality: it's mixed with straw. Straw is bedding, not food for guinea pigs.

The guinea pig pellets are also very expensive and of poor quality: full of grains that are not part of the species' diet. I won't be going back, even as a last resort.
For a "specialized" shop, the quality is truly mediocre.

I have a big, two-year-old Rottweiler, and I have to say the team was absolutely LOVELY with us. When you have big dogs, you're used to hesitation and worry, but here there was none of that. Lots of kisses and, above all, great advice and a surprisingly wide selection for a small city pet shop. Madara is always so happy to go there because he knows he'll get lots of cuddles! Thank you to the whole team for the wonderful welcome.

The groomer is absolutely wonderful with my little dog. My dog ​​is afraid of water, but with him, it's a joy. He's patient, very gentle, and very calm; he knows exactly what to do. Plus, he always comes out spotless, with a great trim and a perfect coat. That's what everyone tells me every time I take him to the groomer.

I'm very happy with him and I trust this person completely. He's very meticulous because I wouldn't entrust my little one to just anyone. I take my dog ​​there without hesitation.

I recommend him to everyone I know.

The store's layout and the availability of products make it an ideal solution for quickly meeting my pet's needs. I appreciate this store for its convenience and wide selection.
